events.title: Beverly Hills Art Show
events.venue: Beverly Gardens Park — 455 N Rexford Dr, Beverly Hills, CA 90210
events.blurb: 250 artists from around the world in a free outdoor garden show. Wine garden, live music, food trucks.
events.description: Biannual outdoor art exhibition across four garden blocks in the heart of Beverly Hills. 250 artists show original paintings, sculpture, ceramics, photography, glass, jewelry, and mixed media. Wine and beer garden with live music, demonstrating artists, kids' activities, gourmet food trucks. Free admission, rain or shine.

events.title: EEEEEATSCON Los Angeles
events.venue: Barker Hangar — 3021 Airport Ave, Santa Monica, CA 90405
events.blurb: Food festival showcasing 20+ acclaimed LA restaurants plus live music and panels.
events.description: EEEEEATSCON is a two-day food festival designed for people who want a full meal, not just bites. 20+ acclaimed restaurants from LA and across the country serve their signature dishes in an indoor hangar setting. Live music and panel discussions round out the program. GA tickets from $25.

events.title: Artazan — Handcraft Show at Pasadena Convention Center
events.venue: Pasadena Convention Center — 300 E Green St, Pasadena, CA 91101
events.blurb: 200+ handcraft exhibitors: jewelry, woodwork, ceramics, clothing, food. $8 entry.
events.description: Artazan brings 200+ juried handcraft exhibitors to the Pasadena Convention Center for a weekend of artisan goods. Categories include jewelry, woodwork, ceramics, wearables, and specialty food. Walking distance if you're in Old Pasadena. Tickets $8 at the door.

events.title: MOCA Annual Plant Sale
events.venue: MOCA Grand Avenue — 250 S Grand Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90012
events.blurb: Artists and growers sell rare plants, handmade ceramics, and botanical goods outside a contemporary art museum. Free.
events.description: MOCA's annual plant market brings together artists, ceramicists, and specialty growers offering unique plants alongside handmade pots, planters, and botanical goods. Free entry — one of those quietly lovely Saturday detours in DTLA. Adjacent to the Broad and Bunker Hill steps.

events.title: Golden Hour with Lula Washington Dance Theatre
events.venue: LACMA David Geffen Galleries — 5905 Wilshire Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90036
events.blurb: Dancers from Lula Washington move through LACMA's new galleries as golden-hour light shifts across the art.
events.description: Members of the Lula Washington Dance Theatre perform in and around LACMA's newly opened David Geffen Galleries, responding in real time to both the building's architectural light and the permanent collection artworks on the walls. The golden hour of late-afternoon sun becomes part of the choreography. Ticket required for museum entry.

events.title: Pasadena Pickup Ultimate Frisbee (Sat)
events.venue: Hahamongna Watershed Park — 4550 Oak Grove Dr, Pasadena, CA 91103
events.blurb: Free recurring Saturday pickup ultimate, all skill levels. ~10 min from home.
events.description: Long-running Saturday pickup ultimate at Hahamongna. Mix of skill levels, casual welcoming vibe. Just show up. Bring water, cleats optional, dark + light shirt for teams. Free, recurring every Saturday.

events.title: Rose Bowl Sunday Pickup Ultimate
events.venue: Brookside Park (near Rose Bowl) — Pasadena, CA 91103
events.blurb: Competitive Sunday pickup ultimate. New players welcome. ~5 min from home.
events.description: Recurring Sunday pickup ultimate near the Rose Bowl at Brookside Park. More competitive than Hahamongna but new players explicitly welcomed. Free to show up. Contact Seth (213-413-4166) if unsure of location.

events.title: Pickwick Vintage Show at ROW DTLA
events.venue: ROW DTLA — 777 S Alameda St, Los Angeles, CA 90021
events.blurb: 70+ California vintage dealers selling clothing, jewelry, textiles, and accessories from all eras. $10 entry.
events.description: The Pickwick Vintage Show is a major source for collectors, connoisseurs, and the design community — 70+ exhibitors from across California bringing vintage clothing, jewelry, textiles, and accessories of all eras to ROW DTLA. Early buyers get first pick at 10am; general admission opens at noon. $10 entry.

events.title: Market Place@PAM: Creativity and Tradition
events.venue: USC Pacific Asia Museum — 46 N Los Robles Ave, Pasadena, CA 91101
events.blurb: AAPI artisan market inside a Pasadena museum. Free. Jewelry, ceramics, textiles, food — museum admission included.
events.description: Artisanal market celebrating AAPI Heritage Month, hosted inside the USC Pacific Asia Museum — walkable from Old Pasadena. Featured artisans include Stacy Wong Handmade, Emily Young Ceramics, Honey My Heart, and Kasih Co-op. Museum admission included with free tickets; free parking. One of the most locally convenient weird-niche markets of the month.

events.title: O-Launch Annual Exhibition 2026 — Otis College
events.venue: Otis College of Art and Design — 9045 Lincoln Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045
events.blurb: Graduating BFA/MFA open studios + student fashion show + ceramics sale. Free public event.
events.description: Otis College transforms its Westchester campus into a sprawling showcase of graduating BFA and MFA work across fine arts, graphic design, illustration, and product design. Highlights: open studios 5-10pm, ceramics sale 5-8pm, alumni reception 5:30-7pm, and a full student fashion show 8-9pm. Free and open to the public.

events.title: LA Coffee Festival (inaugural) — Magic Box LA
events.venue: Magic Box LA — 1933 S Broadway, Los Angeles, CA 90007
events.blurb: First-ever LA Coffee Festival: specialty roasters, unique beans, snacks, and live entertainment.
events.description: The inaugural LA Coffee Festival fills Magic Box LA with specialty roasters and coffee shops showcasing unique beans, baked goods, and snacks alongside live entertainment. An immersive coffee-culture experience — the kind of niche one-day festival that only exists because enough people in LA take coffee extremely seriously.

events.title: Brassroots District: LA '74 — Final Weeks (Sat + Sun)
events.venue: Jewel's Catch One — 4067 W Pico Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90019
events.blurb: Extended run through June: 1970s immersive funk theater where a 9-piece live band plays while the story unfolds around you. 21+.
events.description: Brassroots District: LA '74 has extended its critically acclaimed run at Jewel's Catch One through June after selling out its initial run. Nine-piece live funk band performs original music while actors playing journalists, fans, and record executives move through the crowd — you're inside a 1974 album-release night. Two hours. 21+. GA from ~$59, VIP seating from ~$125.

events.title: Donate blood — Pasadena Red Cross Walnut St Center (Sat 5/16) + $20 Amazon gift card
events.venue: Pasadena Red Cross Blood, Platelet and Plasma Donation Center — 2471 E Walnut St #103, Pasadena, CA 91107
events.blurb: Closest Red Cross center (~6 min from home). Donate by May 17 and get a $20 Amazon gift card by email.
events.description: The Walnut St center (2471 E Walnut St, Suite 103) is the closest Red Cross location to your house — about 6 minutes. Hours on Sat 5/16: 8am-2:45pm. Special May 2026 promo: donors who give between May 1-17 receive a $20 Amazon gift card by email. Schedule at redcrossblood.org or call 1-800-RED-CROSS.

events.title: Donate blood — Pasadena Red Cross Walnut St Center (Sun 5/17) + $20 Amazon gift card
events.venue: Pasadena Red Cross Blood, Platelet and Plasma Donation Center — 2471 E Walnut St #103, Pasadena, CA 91107
events.blurb: Last day of May promo: donate and get a $20 Amazon gift card by email. 6 min from home.
events.description: The Walnut St center (2471 E Walnut St, Suite 103) is the closest Red Cross location to your house. Hours on Sun 5/17: 8am-2:30pm. Last day of the May 2026 promo — donors who give by May 17 receive a $20 Amazon gift card by email. Schedule at redcrossblood.org or call 1-800-RED-CROSS.

events.title: 40th Annual Bug Fair — Natural History Museum
events.venue: Natural History Museum of LA County — 900 Exposition Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90007
events.blurb: 40th annual insect celebration: live bugs, edible-bug stations, entomologist talks, weird arthropod marketplace.
events.description: The NHM's signature signature-weird event turns 40 this year. Up-close encounters with scorpions, tarantulas, cockroaches, beetles; entomologists giving talks; an edible-insect tasting station; vendors selling live arthropods, pinned specimens, books, and bug-themed art; kids' hands-on crafts. Members get exclusive access 9-10am Saturday. Included with museum admission.

events.title: Venice Family Clinic Art Exhibition + Auction — FINAL day
events.venue: 910 Abbot Kinney Blvd, Venice, CA 90291
events.blurb: Free contemporary-art exhibition; last day of the silent auction (closes 5/17). Gagosian-affiliated artists.
events.description: Long-running benefit pairing collectors with major contemporary artists. The on-site exhibition at 910 Abbot Kinney is free and open to the public daily 11am-6pm; Sunday May 17 is the closing day of the silent auction (online bids accepted through 5/17). Featured artists span Gagosian/MOCA-tier names alongside emerging studios. Walk the show even if you aren't bidding — it's a rare free-admission look at a tightly curated set.

events.title: Los Angeles Old Time Social — 16th Year
events.venue: Velaslavasay Panorama — 1122 W 24th St, Los Angeles, CA 90007
events.blurb: All-day festival of American old-time fiddle, banjo, workshops, jam sessions, and a high-energy square dance. One of LA's strangest venues.
events.description: The 16th annual Los Angeles Old Time Social takes over the Velaslavasay Panorama — LA's hand-painted cylindrical panorama museum — with a full day of old-time Appalachian music: beginner workshops, open jam sessions, a contradance caller, and an evening square dance. All-day pass $45; workshops + jams only $30; square dance + evening program only $20. Bring an instrument or just come to dance.

events.title: The Queer Mercado at Olvera Street
events.venue: La Placita Olvera — 845 N Alameda St, Los Angeles, CA 90012
events.blurb: First queer Latino cultural celebration at Olvera Street: 40 vendors, drag performers, DJs, live painters, fashion showcase, wellness experiences. Free, all-ages.
events.description: The Queer Mercado makes its historic debut at Olvera Street — LA's oldest street and a deeply symbolic Chicano cultural site — with 40 LGBTQ+ and Latino vendors, drag performers, DJs, live mural painters, a fashion showcase, and wellness activations. Free admission, all ages. A genuinely unique collision of communities and histories.

events.title: A24 Backrooms Experience — FINAL day
events.venue: Secret address — Burbank, CA (revealed at RSVP)
events.blurb: A24's free immersive pop-up: wander eerie yellow wallpaper mazes and fluorescent liminal spaces from Backrooms lore. Sunday is the last day.
events.description: A24's free pop-up based on creepypasta Backrooms lore closes Sunday 5/17. Walk through a series of eerie rooms — yellow institutional wallpaper, humming fluorescent lights, hidden passages — culminating in a jarring tropical paradise room. Address is a secret given at RSVP. Free but timed entry; book in advance. Some slots still available as of 5/15.

events.title: Street Food Cinema Opening Night: Ferris Bueller's Day Off (40th Anniversary)
events.venue: LA State Historic Park — 1245 N Spring St, Los Angeles, CA 90012
events.blurb: Outdoor opening-night screening of Ferris Bueller's Day Off (40th anniversary) with live music from Featherborn, multiple food trucks, and comedy by Justin Rupple.
events.description: Street Food Cinema kicks off its 2026 season at LA State Historic Park with Ferris Bueller's Day Off to mark the film's 40th anniversary. Live music by Featherborn opens the show, comedy hosting by Justin Rupple, and 20+ food trucks on site. BYO lawn chairs/blankets. GA from $29.94. One of the best outdoor-film venues in LA.

events.title: Talks & Telescopes at Mt. Wilson Observatory
events.venue: Mt. Wilson Observatory — Angeles National Forest, CA 91023
events.blurb: Astronomy talks by scientists, then hands-on stargazing through the same telescopes Edwin Hubble used. $50.
events.description: The Mt. Wilson Institute hosts its signature evening astronomy program: lectures on current research by observatory scientists, followed by guided stargazing through both portable instruments and the historic 60-inch Hale telescope (the world's largest working reflector when Hubble used it). ~45 min drive from Pasadena up the mountain. $50 per person; book in advance.

events.title: Raoul Peck's "Orwell: 2+2=5" screening — Philosophical Research Society
events.venue: 7th House at Philosophical Research Society — 3910 Los Feliz Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90027
events.blurb: Documentary on George Orwell's life and legacy screened inside LA's most esoteric institution — a 1930s occult library and lecture hall.
events.description: Raoul Peck's documentary exploring Orwell's biography and continued relevance (Orwell: 2+2=5) screens at the 7th House, the intimate screening room inside the Philosophical Research Society — Manly P. Hall's 1934 occult library in Los Feliz. The venue alone is worth the trip. Paid tickets via Eventbrite.

events.title: Venice Beach Half Marathon & 5K
events.venue: Ocean View Park, Venice Beach — start/finish near Abbot Kinney Blvd, Venice, CA 90291
events.blurb: 2nd annual scenic coastal race along the Venice boardwalk + canals. Live bands, singing gondolier, post-race celebration.
events.description: Second annual Venice Beach running races: half marathon launches at 7am, 5K at 8am, both with scenic routes along the Venice boardwalk and canal neighborhoods. Live bands and a singing gondolier along the course. Finish-line celebration with food/drinks. Paid entry via runvenicebeach.com.

events.title: The Beach Boys 5K & Wellness Day — Pet Sounds 60th Anniversary
events.venue: Palisades Park / Third Street Promenade — Santa Monica, CA 90401
events.blurb: Pet Sounds' 60th anniversary themed 5K with pre-race meditation by Mike Love, a pooch run, and ocean-conservation beneficiary. Weird.
events.description: A 5K celebrating the 60th anniversary of the Beach Boys' Pet Sounds album — themed race with pre-race group meditation led by Beach Boys' Mike Love, a separate pooch run for dogs, and ocean-preservation as the charity beneficiary. Starts and finishes in Palisades Park in Santa Monica along the ocean. Paid entry.

events.title: LA Fleet Week Dodgeball Tournament (presented by FOX Sports)
events.venue: LA Fleet Week (Port of LA, San Pedro)
events.blurb: 1-day dodgeball tournament + Memorial Day fleet week festival w/ Navy ship tours.
events.description: Single-day dodgeball tournament held during LA Fleet Week (May 22-25) at the Port of LA in San Pedro. Free festival with Navy/Coast Guard ship tours, live entertainment, military demos. The dodgeball is part of the broader weekend programming — sign up to play or just show up to spectate.

events.title: Dance Quest Silent Disco Hike — Griffith Park
events.venue: Spring Canyon, 5400 Griffith Park Dr, Los Angeles, CA 90027
events.blurb: Guided Griffith Park hike with wireless headphones playing Elder Millennial dance hits — hike and dance simultaneously.
events.description: Dance Quest Events leads a 1.5-mile loop through Spring Canyon in Griffith Park. Each participant gets wireless headphones playing a curated Elder Millennial playlist; the group dances while hiking. Easy-to-medium difficulty, all ages 6+. Google Maps recommended (Apple Maps gives wrong directions). 1-hour event.

events.title: Compton Community Cricket Day 2026
events.venue: Kelly Park, 2319 E Caldwell St, Compton, CA 90221
events.blurb: Free community cricket festival — youth matches, pickup cricket, food vendors. Watch or play, zero cricket experience needed.
events.description: The Southern California Junior Cricket Academy and Compton Parks & Rec host a free daylong cricket celebration at Kelly Park. Watch youth leagues play, get a demo, or jump into pickup games. Food vendors, community org booths, family activities. One of the few accessible pickup cricket events in the LA basin — great for total newcomers.

events.title: Intro to Risograph Printing Workshop
events.venue: International Printing Museum, 315 W Torrance Blvd, Carson, CA 90745
events.blurb: Hands-on risograph printing at a working museum — swap color drums, layer prints, take home 15 two-color prints.
events.description: Instructors Jun Ha and Dave Bow walk participants through the full risograph workflow on the museum's SF5130 Risograph duplicator: image file setup, color drum swaps, layered printing, and registration. Bring black-and-white photos (5x7 or smaller) for collage if you like. All materials provided; participants leave with 15 limited-edition 8.5x11 two-color prints. No experience necessary.

events.title: Hansen Dam Aquatic Center — Opening Weekend
events.venue: Hansen Dam Aquatic Center, 11798 Foothill Blvd, Lake View Terrace, CA 91342
events.blurb: The largest public pool in the USA opens for summer 2026 — 1.5-acre pool, water slides, sandy beach. $4 cash only.
events.description: Hansen Dam's massive 1.5-acre pool reopens Memorial Day weekend for summer. Weekend-only hours through June 13, then daily. Features water slides, a sandy beach swimming area, and an adjacent recreation lake. Cash only at the gate. Children under 4 free. Opens at 11am, last entry before 6pm close.

events.title: Art Made by Animals — Showcase & Expert Talks
events.venue: Theosophy Hall, 245 W 33rd St, Los Angeles, CA 90007
events.blurb: Scientists and artists present research on animal creativity — paintings, sculptures, and mixed-media made by non-human artists.
events.description: Android McGregor Productions hosts an evening examining animal cognition and art-making. Dr. Aaron Blaisdell and Andrew McGregor present research on the emerging field of animal creativity, with a live showcase of artwork created by animals (elephants, chimps, crows, and others). 4pm reception, 4:30pm talks + art showcase, 5:30pm Q&A. All ages, in-person only.

events.title: 7 Paintings: An Immersive Dinner Show
events.venue: 8923 Sunset Blvd, West Hollywood, CA 90069
events.blurb: 7-course dinner where each course is a living artwork — projections, live table-side moments, artists from Michelangelo to Banksy.
events.description: A 2-hour immersive dining experience where each of 7 courses is inspired by a master artist (Michelangelo, Banksy, Picasso, Jackson Pollock, Warhol, Dali, Van Gogh). Projections and live table-side performances transform the meal into performance art. ~$175/person + optional drink packages ($53-$81). Tables seat up to 8. Book ahead — this sells out.

events.title: Pupusas and Punchlines — Latin Food + Comedy
events.venue: Jaragua Restaurant, Los Angeles, CA
events.blurb: Late-night Salvadoran food + stand-up comedy — pupusas while watching comics riff on LA life.
events.description: Jaragua Restaurant doubles as a comedy venue for this late show: watch stand-up comedians while eating pupusas and traditional Latin dishes. Part of an ongoing comedy-dining series pairing authentic Salvadoran food with stand-up. Good vibe for groups.

events.title: LA Fleet Week — Main Expo + Battleship Iowa Tours
events.venue: Battleship Iowa, 250 S Harbor Blvd, San Pedro, CA
events.blurb: Free Memorial Day fleet week expo — military hardware on display, Coast Guard demos, free grounds; Battleship Iowa tours $29.95.
events.description: The main LA Fleet Week expo runs Sat 5/23 at the Port of LA's Battleship Iowa footprint. Free access to the expo grounds with military displays, Navy and Coast Guard demonstrations, food, and live entertainment. The Battleship Iowa itself offers ticketed tours ($29.95) for full below-deck access. Part of the May 22-25 fleet week.

events.title: Audiobook Walking Club — Rose Bowl Loop
events.venue: Rose Bowl Stadium, 1001 Rose Bowl Dr, Pasadena, CA 91103
events.blurb: Group 3-mile walk around the Rose Bowl while collectively listening to the same audiobook — earbuds in, discuss at breaks.
events.description: A Pasadena-based walking club where participants sync up on earbuds to the same audiobook chapter while walking the 3-mile Rose Bowl loop. Discussion breaks at key points on the trail. Low-key, social, no prior commitment needed. ~2.5 miles from home — one of the closest events on the board.

events.title: Wild Food Hike — Sturtevant Falls
events.venue: Sturtevant Falls Trailhead (Chantry Flat), Arcadia, CA
events.blurb: Guided hike to Sturtevant Falls while foraging — learn to ID wild edible plants growing along the trail.
events.description: A naturalist leads a foraging hike to Sturtevant Falls in the San Gabriel Mountains. The trail passes through riparian habitat rich in wild edibles; the guide identifies and explains uses for plants found along the way. Waterfall destination at the end. Moderate difficulty, ~3.5 miles round trip. Very close to home.

events.title: Kintsugi Workshop — The Art of Mending with Gold
events.venue: L.A. Cornell Building, Los Angeles, CA
events.blurb: Japanese ceramics repair with gold lacquer — bring your broken mug or bowl and leave with something more beautiful than before.
events.description: Kintsugi is the Japanese art of repairing broken pottery with gold or silver lacquer, treating breaks as part of the object's history. This workshop teaches the technique — participants can bring broken ceramics or work with provided pieces. All materials included. 2-hour session.

events.title: MAINopoly: A Taste of Main Street (11th Annual)
events.venue: Main Street, Santa Monica — check-in at Ashland Hill, 2807 Main St
events.blurb: Monopoly-themed food crawl along 5 blocks of Main St, Santa Monica — game board in hand, trade MAINopoly dollars for tastings at 20+ restaurants.
events.description: The 11th annual MAINopoly turns Main Street Santa Monica into a giant Monopoly board. Participants receive a game board and MAINopoly dollars to exchange for food and drink tastings from 20+ local restaurants including Ashland Hill, Triple Beam Pizza, Michael's, HomeState, and Junior Cookies. Complete your board to enter prize drawings. VIP enters at noon. Proceeds support Main Street Business Improvement Association. GA $40, VIP $60, kids $20.

events.title: Wearable Art 2026 Showcase
events.venue: The Makery, Los Angeles, CA
events.blurb: Exhibition of wearable art — clothing, accessories, and body art as fine art. All wearable, all wild.
events.description: The Makery hosts Wearable Art 2026, an exhibition and showcase where garments, accessories, and body-adornment pieces are presented as works of visual art. Merges fashion design, textile arts, and conceptual art. Great for costume, fashion, and art crowds.

events.title: Bangin vs Buckin: Majorette Meets Clowning Dance Battle
events.venue: Inglewood High School, 10500 Yukon Ave S, Inglewood, CA 90303
events.blurb: DOC Majorettes vs TSquad Clown Dancers — two distinct LA street dance cultures battle it out, zero mercy.
events.description: The Divas of Compton Majorettes and TSquad Clown Dancers face off in a competitive showcase. Majorette and Clowning are distinct LA street-dance traditions; this is one of the few events that pits them against each other head-to-head. Hosted by 1 Shine Youth. 4 hours of performances, crowd energy, and pure LA culture.

events.title: Free Salsa + Bachata — Third Street Promenade
events.venue: Third Street Promenade, Santa Monica, CA
events.blurb: Free outdoor social dancing on the promenade — all levels welcome, no partner needed.
events.description: Weekly outdoor salsa and bachata social dancing on Third Street Promenade in Santa Monica. All levels welcome — total beginners to experienced dancers. No partner required; the social dance format means you rotate. Free to join.

events.title: Donate blood — Pasadena Red Cross Donor Center (Fri 5/22)
events.venue: American Red Cross — Pasadena Donor Center, 133 N Altadena Dr, Pasadena, CA 91107
events.blurb: Free blood/platelet/plasma donation. ~12 min drive from your place. Schedule at redcrossblood.org or 1-800-RED-CROSS.
events.description: Standing hours at the Pasadena Red Cross donor center on Fri 5/22 (8:15am-3:30pm). Walk-in welcome but appointments cut wait time. Most donations take ~1 hour total. Eligibility quick-check: 16+, 110+ lbs, no recent piercings/tattoos in non-licensed shops, no recent malaria-zone travel.

events.title: Donate blood — Pasadena Red Cross Donor Center (Sat 5/23)
events.venue: American Red Cross — Pasadena Donor Center, 133 N Altadena Dr, Pasadena, CA 91107
events.blurb: Free blood/platelet/plasma donation. ~12 min drive from your place. Schedule at redcrossblood.org or 1-800-RED-CROSS.
events.description: Standing weekend hours at the Pasadena Red Cross donor center on Sat 5/23 (7:45am-3pm). Walk-in welcome but appointments cut wait time. Most donations take ~1 hour total. Eligibility quick-check: 16+, 110+ lbs, no recent piercings/tattoos in non-licensed shops, no recent malaria-zone travel.

events.title: Donate blood — Pasadena Red Cross Donor Center (Sun 5/24)
events.venue: American Red Cross — Pasadena Donor Center, 133 N Altadena Dr, Pasadena, CA 91107
events.blurb: Free blood/platelet/plasma donation. ~12 min drive from your place. Schedule at redcrossblood.org or 1-800-RED-CROSS.
events.description: Standing weekend hours at the Pasadena Red Cross donor center on Sun 5/24 (7:45am-2:30pm). Walk-in welcome but appointments cut wait time. Most donations take ~1 hour total. Eligibility quick-check: 16+, 110+ lbs, no recent piercings/tattoos in non-licensed shops, no recent malaria-zone travel.

events.title: Ghouls' Day Out 2026
events.venue: Immanuel Presbyterian Church, 3300 Wilshire Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90005
events.blurb: Alt/emo culture festival at the church from MCR's 'Helena' video — 60+ vendors, tribute bands, immersive photo ops. Costumes encouraged.
events.description: All-ages celebration of alternative and emo culture at the historic church featured in My Chemical Romance's 'Helena' music video. Features tribute band performances, a vendor market with 60+ alternative creators, 'The Sanctuary Experience' immersive atmospheric photo ops, and meet-and-greet opportunities. VIP sold out; General Admission available. Children under 12 free. Costumes encouraged, foam props welcome.

events.title: Summer Corgi Nationals
events.venue: Santa Anita Park, 285 Huntington Drive, Arcadia, CA 91007
events.blurb: SoCal's corgis sprint the Santa Anita racetrack — racing finals + vendor village + real horse races + bring your own corgi.
events.description: Southern California corgis compete in racing semifinals and finals on the main track at historic Santa Anita Park alongside traditional horse racing. Includes a vendor village with corgi-themed merchandise, food trucks, carnival activities, and the option to bring your own corgi (with guidelines). GA $12 online / $17 walk-up; VIP $55 includes t-shirt, $5 betting voucher, and premium infield seating. Kids 17 and under free.

events.title: Down the Rabbit Hole — Immersive Burlesque Cabaret
events.venue: Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel, 7000 Hollywood Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90028
events.blurb: Enter through a secret bookcase door at the Hollywood Roosevelt and tumble into an 18+ Alice in Wonderland burlesque cabaret — sultry performances, hypnotic visuals, 90 minutes.
events.description: FeverUp's 'Down the Rabbit Hole' transforms Lewis Carroll's classic into an adult-oriented 90-minute immersive cabaret experience at the legendary Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel. Enter through a secret entrance hidden behind a bookcase. Inside: larger-than-life Wonderland characters, burlesque-inspired performances, and cinematic visuals that blur fantasy and reality. Cocktails and light bites available. 18+ only. Running May 23 through Sep 12; multiple showtimes available.

events.title: Sunday Downtown Swinga — Cypher, Live Music, Comedy & Jam Session
events.venue: Booyaka Lounge, 464 Main Street, Los Angeles, CA 90013
events.blurb: Free weekly DTLA cypher where artists, musicians, comedians, and poets collide — open mic, live performances, late-night jam session. No cover.
events.description: Sunday Downtown Swinga is a recurring weekly gathering at Booyaka Lounge in DTLA where rappers, musicians, comedians, spoken word poets, and creatives share the same stage. Cypher/open mic runs 8-10pm (Early Bird), followed by live performances and an all-hands jam session. No cover charge; $5 specials on beer, wings, and onion rings during early hours. Runs every Sunday — on 5/24 for Memorial Day weekend.

events.title: Big Gay Sunday Memorial Day BBQ & Potluck
events.venue: Pride=Health at ATC & AHP, 1773 Griffith Park Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90026
events.blurb: LGBTQ+ community BBQ potluck with a guided meditation hour built in — bring a dish, leave with laughs and good vibes.
events.description: Pride=Health hosts their Memorial Day gathering at 1773 Griffith Park Blvd in Silver Lake. Schedule: 1pm arrival and mingling, 1:30-2:30pm guided group meditation, 2:30-4pm potluck celebration. Attendees are encouraged to bring a dish to share. Community-centered, LGBTQ+ friendly, all welcome.

events.title: Fiesta Hermosa
events.venue: Hermosa Beach Pier Plaza + Valley Park — Hermosa and Pier Aves., Hermosa Beach
events.blurb: Memorial Day weekend institution since 1973: 3-day free beach arts festival with 200+ artisan vendors, beer garden, local bands.
events.description: Running since 1973, Fiesta Hermosa is one of Southern California's longest-running arts festivals. Three days of 200+ juried artisan booths, live local music on multiple stages, a craft beer garden, food vendors, kids' activities, and the pure perfection of Hermosa Beach in late May. Free general admission; beer garden has an entry fee. One of the most reliably good Memorial Day weekend options in LA.

events.title: Echo Park Pride
events.venue: El Centro Del Pueblo, 1715 Violet St, Los Angeles, CA 90026
events.blurb: Free neighborhood Pride in Echo Park — grassroots and community-rooted, distinct from the WeHo spectacle.
events.description: Echo Park Pride is a free, community-organized Pride event through El Centro Del Pueblo. Lower-key and more neighborhood-rooted than WeHo Pride, with local vendors, performers, and families mixing in a parkside setting. A different energy than the bigger commercial events. Free to attend.

events.title: Soundbath, Sea and Sails
events.venue: Burton Chace Park, 13650 Mindanao Way, Marina del Rey, CA
events.blurb: Outdoor soundbath on the marina waterfront — gongs, bowls, salt air, sailboats. $30 suggested donation.
events.description: A guided outdoor soundbath session at Burton Chace Park directly on the Marina del Rey waterfront. Participants lie on the grass as gongs and singing bowls wash over them with ocean air and sailboat masts framing the scene. $30 suggested donation. Bring a mat or blanket. The combination of water, boats, and sound makes this distinctly LA-niche.

events.title: Cinespia: E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial — Memorial Day Outdoor Screening

events.description: Every Sunday Smorgasburg packs 50+ food vendors at ROW DTLA. June 14 launches 'The World Grub' World Cup activation with an international DJ lineup, a mini soccer pitch, limited merch and game-time specials. Free entry, free 2-hr parking.

events.title: Academy Museum Fútbol Free Day
events.venue: Academy Museum of Motion Pictures, 6067 Wilshire Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90036
events.blurb: FREE entry to the Academy Museum for FIFA World Cup weekend: 35mm soccer films, human foosball on the lawn, free fruit cups, Fanny's taco stand.
events.description: The Academy Museum opens free for FIFA World Cup 2026 weekend. Screenings in the David Geffen Theater: Bend It Like Beckham (11am), Shaolin Soccer (2:30pm), Offside (5pm) — all on 35mm. Outside: inflatable human foosball 11am-4pm, free fruit cups (first-come), Fanny's taco stand 12-5pm. Usual $25 ticket waived. Spanish-language Jaws tour at 12:30pm. Exhibitions include Jaws, Studio Ghibli's Ponyo, and Barbie to Anna Karenina.

events.title: UFOs & Their Spiritual Message
events.venue: The Aetherius Society American HQ, 6202 Afton Place, Los Angeles, CA 90028
events.blurb: Pranayama breathing + heart chakra activation + extraterrestrial contact lecture at LA's legitimately strange UFO-spiritual society, followed by free social with refreshments. $15.
events.description: The Aetherius Society — a real UFO-religion founded in 1950s London, with American headquarters in Hollywood — hosts this evening on extraterrestrial contact and its implications for science and consciousness. Includes guided pranayama yoga breathing, heart chakra activation, and a talk on raising global consciousness by Julian Rosser (author, 'One Elephant') and Lisa Rosser. Free drinks at the social after. $15. This place is legitimately wild: they believe Saturn is a cosmic radio transmitter for spiritual energy.

events.title: Bayou Bash: A Southern Gothic Party
events.venue: Slasher World, 7660 Melrose Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90046
events.blurb: Swamp-folklore immersive party at a horror pop-up shop: live serpent photo ops, Cajun food, book signing for 'Swamp Sorcery', 9pm ritual with Mystic Dylan. 21+. $25 GA.
events.description: Slasher World — a horror memorabilia shop on Melrose — transforms into a bayou for a Southern Gothic party featuring themed cocktails, Cajun eats, live entertainment, and a 9pm ritual performance by Mystic Dylan. Live serpent photo opportunities, book signings for 'Swamp Sorcery', and a VIP Coven Circle experience (13 spots, $113) with a personalized signed book, meal, and mini reading. GA $25, Bayou Baby $50. Dress code: Southern Gothic, swamp witch, dark Victorian. 21+.

events.title: Strings & Things: Open Fiber Arts Club

events.blurb: Free outdoor crochet and yarn circle at a Pasadena bookshop/boba cafe. Bring a project or start one — supplies available. 1.5 mi from home.
events.description: A recurring open fiber arts club at dym books & boba, a beloved indie bookshop+boba spot in Pasadena. Bring your own crochet/knitting project or start fresh — crochet needles and yarn are on hand. The host calls it a gathering to 'foster community with local fiber artists.' Outdoors, RSVP encouraged. 1.5 miles from home.

events.title: Ultimate Werewolf Game Night
events.venue: Groundfloor, 160 Glendale Blvd, Los Angeles, CA (Echo Park)
events.blurb: 79-person social deduction game night (part Mafia, part board game) in Echo Park. Free drinks, potluck snacks. $5 optional. Newcomers explicitly welcome.
events.description: The LA Werewolf Meetup Group packs Echo Park's Groundfloor for an Ultimate Werewolf marathon — a card/board game hybrid where Villagers try to identify hidden Wolves before sunrise. 79 attendees registered, rated 4.9/5. Organizer Brandon walks everyone through the rules at the start. Free coffee, tea, and water provided; attendees bring potluck snacks. $5 optional donation for space costs. Friendly crowd, extra games if time permits.

Three-day run (Jun 19-21) with 200+ vendors serving Taiwanese street food, Korean BBQ, Japanese snacks, bubble tea, handcrafted merch, and live musical performances. Free admission, complimentary parking. Very local crowd.

events.title: Vampire Beach Party Skate Night (All Ages)

events.description: Moonlight Rollerway is a genuine 1956 roller rink in Glendale — wood floor, Wurlitzer pipe organ, deeply retro energy. This Vampire Beach Party themed skate night is all-ages with costumes strongly encouraged, running 8-11pm. Admission only (bring your own skates to save the rental fee). One of the most lovably weird themed nights in greater LA.
